  179  export class AstEditTool implements AgentTool<typeof astEditSchema, AstEditToolDetails> {
  180  	readonly name = "ast_edit";
  181  	readonly approval = (args: unknown) => {
  182  		const paths = Array.isArray((args as Partial<AstEditSchemaInfer>).paths)
  183  			? ((args as Partial<AstEditSchemaInfer>).paths as string[])
  184  			: [];
  185  		return paths.length > 0 && paths.every(path => isInternalUrlPath(path)) ? "read" : "write";
  186  	};
  187  	readonly formatApprovalDetails = (args: unknown): string[] => {
  188  		const params = args as Partial<AstEditSchemaInfer>;
  189  		const lines: string[] = [];
  190  		const ops = Array.isArray(params.ops) ? params.ops : [];
  191  		const firstOp = ops[0];
  192  		if (firstOp) {
  193  			lines.push(`Pattern: ${truncateForPrompt(firstOp.pat)}`);
  194  			lines.push(`Replacement: ${truncateForPrompt(firstOp.out)}`);
  195  			if (ops.length > 1) {
  196  				lines.push(`+${ops.length - 1} more op${ops.length === 2 ? "" : "s"}`);
  197  			}
  198  		}
  199  		if (Array.isArray(params.paths) && params.paths.length > 0) {
  200  			lines.push(`Paths: ${truncateForPrompt(params.paths.join(", "))}`);
  201  		}
  202  		return lines;
  203  	};

  547  		const rawCommand = (args as Partial<BashToolInput>).command;
  548  		const command = typeof rawCommand === "string" ? rawCommand : "";
  549  		const patternRules = getBashApprovalPatternRules(this.session.settings.get("bash.patterns"));
  550  		const patternRule = findBashApprovalPatternRule(command, patternRules);
  551  		if (patternRule?.approval === "deny") {
  552  			return {
  553  				tier: "exec",
  554  				override: true,
  555  				policy: "deny",
  556  				reason: `Blocked by bash pattern: ${patternRule.match}`,
  557  			};
  558  		}
  559  		if (command !== "" && CRITICAL_BASH_PATTERNS.some(pattern => pattern.test(command))) {
  560  			return { tier: "exec", override: true, reason: "Critical pattern detected" };
  561  		}
  562  		if (patternRule?.approval === "allow") return { tier: "write", policy: "allow" };
  563  		if (patternRule?.approval === "prompt") {
  564  			return {
  565  				tier: "exec",
  566  				override: true,
  567  				policy: "prompt",
  568  				reason: `Prompt required by bash pattern: ${patternRule.match}`,
  569  			};
  570  		}
  571  		return "exec";
  572  	};

  239  		"Generate a speech audio file from text and write it to output_path. Two backends, selected by the providers.tts setting (auto|local|xai): " +
  240  		`local = on-device neural TTS (Kokoro-82M via the bundled ONNX runtime, no network, output is always WAV/PCM16; voice set by the tts.localVoice setting — ${KOKORO_VOICES.map(v => (v.id === DEFAULT_TTS_VOICE ? `${v.id} (default)` : v.id)).join(", ")}); ` +
  241  		`xai = xAI Grok Voice cloud (built-in voices: ${formatVoiceList()}; custom voice IDs accepted; MP3 or WAV). ` +
  242  		"auto prefers local, but routes an .mp3 request to xAI when credentials exist (only the cloud path emits MP3); " +
  243  		"otherwise an .mp3 path is written as a sibling .wav. xAI codec is inferred from the output_path suffix. " +
  244  		`Max ${XAI_MAX_TEXT_LENGTH.toLocaleString("en-US")} characters.`,
  245  	parameters: ttsSchema,
  246  	async execute(
  247  		_toolCallId: string,
  248  		params: TtsSchemaType,
  249  		_onUpdate,
  250  		ctx: CustomToolContext,
  251  		signal?: AbortSignal,
  252  	): Promise<AgentToolResult<TtsToolDetails, TtsSchemaType>> {
  253  		const cwd = ctx.sessionManager.getCwd();
  254  		const outputPath = resolveToCwd(params.output_path, cwd);
  255  		const displayPath = formatPathRelativeToCwd(outputPath, cwd);
  256  		const codec: TtsCodec = outputPath.toLowerCase().endsWith(".wav") ? "wav" : "mp3";
  257
  258  		const preference = readStringSetting("providers.tts") ?? "auto";
  259  		// Only resolve xAI creds when they can affect routing (skip for an explicit local preference).
  260  		const hasXaiCreds =
  261  			preference === "local" ? false : (await resolveXAIHttpCredentials(ctx.modelRegistry)) !== null;
  262  		const backend = resolveTtsBackend({ preference, wantsMp3: codec === "mp3", hasXaiCreds });
  263
  264  		if (backend === "local") return synthesizeLocal(params, cwd, outputPath, signal);
  265  		return synthesizeXai(params, ctx, outputPath, displayPath, codec, signal);

  498   *
  499   * Creates or overwrites files with optional LSP formatting and diagnostics.

  501  export class WriteTool implements AgentTool<typeof writeSchema, WriteToolDetails> {
  502  	readonly name = "write";
  503  	readonly approval = (args: unknown): ToolApprovalDecision => {
  504  		const rawPath = (args as Partial<WriteParams>).path;
  505  		if (typeof rawPath !== "string") return "write";
  506  		// Unwrap a hashline `[path#TAG]` wrapper first (parity with execute) so a
  507  		// wrapped `[ssh://h/x#ABCD]` can't dodge scheme detection and the tier checks below.
  508  		const path = unwrapHashlineHeaderPath(rawPath);
  509  		// xd:// device writes execute the mounted tool — take its approval tier.
  510  		// The resolution devices (xd://resolve, xd://reject, xd://propose)
  511  		// finalize a staged, already-previewed action, so they stay at read tier.
  512  		const xdevTarget = parseXdUrl(path);
  513  		if (xdevTarget) {
  514  			if (xdevTarget.name === REPORT_ISSUE_DEVICE_NAME) return "write";
  515  			if (xdevTarget.name && isResolutionDeviceName(xdevTarget.name)) return "read";
  516  			const inst =
  517  				xdevTarget.name && this.session.xdev ? resolveXdevTool(this.session.xdev, xdevTarget.name) : undefined;
  518  			if (!inst) return "exec";
  519  			// Decode the device JSON payload and evaluate the mounted tool's own
  520  			// approval (which may be argument-dependent, e.g. ast_edit is read-tier
  521  			// for internal-URL paths, debug is read-tier for inspection actions).
  522  			// Malformed JSON, non-object payloads, missing content, and approval
  523  			// functions that reject schema-invalid objects stay exec so the gate
  524  			// fails closed — the dispatch itself rejects invalid arguments too.
  525  			const rawContent = (args as Partial<WriteParams>).content;
  526  			if (typeof rawContent !== "string") return "exec";
  527  			let parsed: unknown;
  528  			try {
  529  				parsed = JSON.parse(rawContent);
  530  			} catch {
  531  				return "exec";
  532  			}
  533  			if (!isRecord(parsed)) return "exec";
  534  			try {
  535  				// The tier is the mounted tool's own (argument-dependent) approval; the
  536  				// policyKey makes the outer gate consult `tools.approval.<device>` for
  537  				// this dispatch before falling back to `tools.approval.write`, so users
  538  				// can scope allow/deny/prompt to a single device (issue #7923).
  539  				return { tier: resolveToolTier(inst, parsed), policyKey: xdevTarget.name! };
  540  			} catch {
  541  				return "exec";
  542  			}
  543  		}
  544  		// Remote SSH writes open an outbound connection and run a remote shell —
  545  		// gate them like the exec-tier `ssh` tool, ahead of the handler-write
  546  		// logic. Substring match also covers selector-suffixed targets.
  547  		if (pathTargetsSsh(path)) return "exec";
  548  		if (!isInternalUrlPath(path)) return "write";
  549  		// Internal URLs are usually session-local artifacts (read tier), but a
  550  		// scheme whose handler exposes a `write` hook mutates handler-owned user
  551  		// data (e.g. vault:// notes) and must take the write tier so always-ask
  552  		// mode actually prompts.
  553  		const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(path.trim());
  554  		const handler = match ? InternalUrlRouter.instance().getHandler(match[1]!.toLowerCase()) : undefined;
  555  		return handler?.write ? "write" : "read";
  556  	};
  557  	readonly formatApprovalDetails = (args: unknown): string[] => {
  558  		const params = args as Partial<WriteParams>;
  559  		const targetPath = typeof params.path === "string" ? params.path : "(missing)";
  560  		const content = typeof params.content === "string" ? params.content : "";
  561  		return [`Path: ${truncateForPrompt(targetPath)}`, `Content:\n${truncateForPrompt(content)}`];

  160
  161  /**
  162   * Single-line ANSI progress reporter. `update(done)` rewrites the line via
  163   * `\r`; `finish()` newlines out so subsequent log lines land cleanly. On a
  164   * non-TTY stdout (CI, pipes) both calls no-op so log files don't fill with
  165   * carriage-return noise.
  166   */
  167  interface ProgressBar {
  168  	update(done: number): void;
  169  	finish(): void;
  170  }
  171
  172  function makeProgressBar(total: number, width = 30): ProgressBar {
  173  	const isTty = !!process.stdout.isTTY;
  174  	if (!isTty || total === 0) {
  175  		return { update: () => undefined, finish: () => undefined };
  176  	}
  177  	const render = (done: number): void => {
  178  		const ratio = Math.min(1, done / total);
  179  		const filled = Math.round(ratio * width);
  180  		const bar = `${"█".repeat(filled)}${"░".repeat(width - filled)}`;
  181  		const pct = `${Math.floor(ratio * 100)
  182  			.toString()
  183  			.padStart(3, " ")}%`;
  184  		process.stdout.write(`\r${chalk.cyan("Pushing")} [${bar}] ${pct} ${done}/${total}`);
  185  	};
  186  	render(0);
  187  	return {
  188  		update: render,
  189  		finish: () => process.stdout.write("\n"),
  190  	};
  191  }

   11  /**
   12   * Build getArgumentCompletions from declarative subcommand definitions.
   13   * Returns subcommand names filtered by prefix in the dropdown.
   14   */
   15  export function buildArgumentCompletions(subcommands: SubcommandDef[]): (prefix: string) => AutocompleteItem[] | null {
   16  	return (argumentPrefix: string) => {
   17  		if (argumentPrefix.includes(" ")) return null; // past the subcommand
   18  		const lower = argumentPrefix.toLowerCase();
   19  		const matches = subcommands
   20  			.filter(s => s.name.startsWith(lower))
   21  			.map(s => ({
   22  				value: `${s.name} `,
   23  				label: s.name,
   24  				description: s.description,
   25  				hint: s.usage,
   26  			}));
   27  		return matches.length > 0 ? matches : null;
   28  	};
   29  }

   23  /**
   24   * Reload the interactive session's plugin runtime: invalidate fs/plugin-root
   25   * caches, rediscover skills, file slash commands, and task agents, reset the
   26   * capability cache, and reconnect MCP servers (rebinding the session's MCP
   27   * tools). Shared by `/reload-plugins`'s TUI handler and the `handle`-adapter's
   28   * `reloadPlugins` hook so both honor the command's documented reload scope.
   29   */
   30  export async function reloadTuiPluginState(ctx: InteractiveModeContext): Promise<void> {
   31  	const projectPath = await resolveActiveProjectRegistryPath(ctx.sessionManager.getCwd());
   32  	clearPluginRootsAndCaches(projectPath ? [projectPath] : undefined);
   33  	await refreshAgentDiscovery(ctx.sessionManager.getCwd());
   34  	await ctx.refreshSkillState();
   35  	await ctx.refreshSlashCommandState();
   36  	resetCapabilities();
   37  	if (ctx.mcpManager) {
   38  		await new MCPCommandController(ctx).reloadServers();
   39  	}
   40  }

   24  async function runWithDetachedModeDraft(
   25  	command: ParsedSlashCommand,
   26  	runtime: TuiSlashCommandRuntime,
   27  	run: () => Promise<boolean>,
   28  ): Promise<void> {
   29  	const { editor } = runtime.ctx;
   30  	if (!runtime.draftDetached) editor.clearDraft();
   31  	try {
   32  		const submitted = await run();
   33  		if (!submitted && ((runtime.input?.images?.length ?? 0) > 0 || (runtime.input?.imageLinks?.length ?? 0) > 0)) {
   34  			editor.pendingImages = [...(runtime.input?.images ?? []), ...editor.pendingImages];
   35  			editor.pendingImageLinks = [
   36  				...(runtime.input?.imageLinks ?? runtime.input?.images?.map(() => undefined) ?? []),
   37  				...editor.pendingImageLinks,
   38  			];
   39  			editor.imageLinks = editor.pendingImageLinks.length > 0 ? editor.pendingImageLinks : undefined;
   40  		}
   41  	} catch (error) {
   42  		if (!editor.getText() && editor.pendingImages.length === 0) {
   43  			editor.setText(command.text);
   44  			editor.pendingImages = runtime.input?.images ? [...runtime.input.images] : [];
   45  			editor.pendingImageLinks = runtime.input?.imageLinks ? [...runtime.input.imageLinks] : [];
   46  			editor.imageLinks = editor.pendingImageLinks.length > 0 ? editor.pendingImageLinks : undefined;
   47  		}
   48  		runtime.ctx.showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
   49  	}
   50  }

   23  async function handleUsageResetCommand(
   24  	arg: string,
   25  	session: AgentSession,
   26  	output: SlashCommandRuntime["output"],
   27  ): Promise<void> {
   28  	let accounts: ResetUsageAccount[];
   29  	try {
   30  		accounts = toResetUsageAccounts(await session.listResetCredits());
   31  	} catch (error) {
   32  		await output(`Could not load saved resets: ${errorMessage(error)}`);
   33  		return;
   34  	}
   35  	if (accounts.length === 0) {
   36  		await output("No Codex accounts found. Use /login to add one.");
   37  		return;
   38  	}
   39  	const targetArg = arg.trim();
   40  	if (!targetArg) {
   41  		const lines = ["Saved Codex rate-limit resets:"];
   42  		for (const account of accounts) {
   43  			const detail = account.error ? `unavailable (${account.error})` : `${account.availableCount} available`;
   44  			lines.push(`- ${account.label}: ${detail}${account.active ? " (active)" : ""}`);
   45  		}
   46  		lines.push("", "Spend one with `/usage reset <account email>` or `/usage reset active`.");
   47  		await output(lines.join("\n"));
   48  		return;
   49  	}
   50  	const wanted = targetArg.toLowerCase();
   51  	const target =
   52  		wanted === "active"
   53  			? accounts.find(account => account.active)
   54  			: accounts.find(
   55  					account =>
   56  						account.label.toLowerCase() === wanted ||
   57  						account.target.email?.toLowerCase() === wanted ||
   58  						account.target.accountId?.toLowerCase() === wanted,
   59  				);
   60  	if (!target) {
   61  		await output(`No Codex account matches "${targetArg}".`);
   62  		return;
   63  	}
   64  	if (target.availableCount <= 0) {
   65  		await output(`${target.label}: no saved resets to spend.`);
   66  		return;
   67  	}
   68  	const outcome = await session.redeemResetCredit(target.target);
   69  	await output(describeRedeemOutcome(outcome, target.label));
   70  }

  204  				if (runtime.session.isStreaming) return usage("Cannot delete the session while streaming.", runtime);
  205  				const sessionFile = runtime.sessionManager.getSessionFile();
  206  				if (!sessionFile) return usage("No session file to delete (in-memory session).", runtime);
  207  				// Route through the active SessionManager so the persist writer is
  208  				// closed before the file is deleted. Constructing a fresh
  209  				// FileSessionStorage and calling deleteSessionWithArtifacts leaves
  210  				// the active writer attached to the now-deleted path, so the next
  211  				// prompt would silently resurrect or corrupt the "deleted" file.
  212  				try {

DIMENSION · ARCHITECTURE

Architecture & ownership

3 located findings; each moves from fact to plain language, engineering impact, and source excerpt.

01
L1factarchitecture

01 · 核心是强化 Agent loop，产品层再叠加大型 Session maintenance 状态机

SOURCE FACT

packages/agent 处理模型、工具、steering 和 telemetry；产品 AgentSession 在 agent_end 后按优先级处理 yield、空 stop、goal compaction、异常 stop、stream stall、model fallback、todo、async wake 和 session_stop。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

内层发动机负责每一步，外层管家负责一步结束后判断要不要重试、压缩、换模型、继续目标或等待后台工作。

IMPLICATION

自治恢复能力强，但 session maintenance 已成为复杂调度器，修改顺序容易产生竞态。

  945  /**
  946   * Resolve aside entries at the moment the loop is about to inject them. Each entry
  947   * is either a ready {@link AgentMessage} or a sync thunk evaluated here so the
  948   * producer can make the final inject-or-drop decision (return null) against
  949   * up-to-the-injection state — e.g. dropping late diagnostics a newer edit
  950   * superseded. Kept sync so it can never stall the loop.
  951   */
  952  function resolveAsides(entries: AsideMessage[] | undefined): AgentMessage[] {
  953  	if (!entries || entries.length === 0) return [];
  954  	const out: AgentMessage[] = [];
  955  	for (const entry of entries) {
  956  		const message = typeof entry === "function" ? entry() : entry;
  957  		if (message) out.push(message);
  958  	}
  959  	return out;
  960  }

  977  		const deadlineReason = new DOMException("Deadline exceeded", "TimeoutError");
  978  		const delay = config.deadline - Date.now();
  979  		if (delay <= 0) {
  980  			deadlineAbortController.abort(deadlineReason);

  982  			deadlineTimer = setTimeout(() => {
  983  				deadlineAbortController.abort(deadlineReason);
  984  			}, delay);
  985  		}
  986  		signal = signal ? AbortSignal.any([signal, deadlineAbortController.signal]) : deadlineAbortController.signal;
  987  	}
  988
  989  	const softRequirementState = config.softToolRequirementState ?? { escalations: 0 };

  984  	}

L1factarchitecture

02 · steering 不只在轮间排队，还能在工具执行中协作中断

SOURCE FACT

loop 每轮前和 stop boundary 轮询 steering/asides；工具批运行时同时使用 hard abort 与 cooperative steeringSignal，interruptible 等待工具会被 steer 打断，普通有副作用工具只收到软信号并在边界注入消息。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

用户插话时，纯等待可以立刻停；正在改文件的工具不会粗暴半路杀死，而是完成到安全边界再让模型听新指令。

IMPLICATION

中断语义按工具类型区分，明显优于统一 AbortController。

03 · 工具调度支持 shared/exclusive 并发和完整 pre-dispatch 改写

SOURCE FACT

tool calls 在流结束前完成参数校验与 beforeToolCall，改写后的参数回写 assistant snapshot；执行时 shared calls 并发，exclusive 会等待之前 exclusive 和所有 shared；afterToolCall 可规范化结果。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

先把所有施工单审核、改好并固化，再按“可并行/独占”排程，日志看到的参数就是实际执行参数。

IMPLICATION

既能并发提速，也能避免 edit/bash 等副作用互撞；第三方结果还在单一边界做防腐。

 2087  function resolveToolForCall(
 2088  	tools: AgentTool<any>[] | undefined,
 2089  	toolCall: AgentToolCall,
 2090  	resolveFallbackTool: AgentLoopConfig["resolveFallbackTool"],
 2091  ): AgentTool<any> | undefined {
 2092  	// Tools emitted via OpenAI's custom-tool path (e.g. `apply_patch` on GPT-5)
 2093  	// come back under their wire-level name, which may differ from the
 2094  	// harness-internal `name`. Match on either, preferring `name` for
 2095  	// determinism if both somehow collide.

 2097  		tools?.find(t => t.name === toolCall.name) ??

 2100  		// (e.g. xd:// device mounts) called by their top-level name.

 2105  /**
 2106   * Pre-dispatch phase for every pending tool call on `assistantMessage`, run in
 2107   * call order: intent extraction, argument validation, and the `beforeToolCall`
 2108   * hook. A hook `args` revision is revalidated against the tool schema and
 2109   * written back to `toolCall.arguments`; run before `message_start`/`message_end`
 2110   * (the streamed path) that makes the revision the single source of truth —
 2111   * history, execution events, persistence, provider replay, concurrency
 2112   * scheduling, and `tool.execute` all agree. Failures are recorded per call and
 2113   * surfaced by `executeToolCalls` at the record's scheduled slot.
 2114   */

 2116  	assistantMessage: AssistantMessage,
 2117  	context: AgentContext,
 2118  	config: AgentLoopConfig,

 2120  ): Promise<Map<string, PreparedToolCall>> {
 2121  	const { resolveFallbackTool, intentTracing, beforeToolCall } = config;
 2122  	const prepared = new Map<string, PreparedToolCall>();
 2123  	for (const toolCall of assistantMessage.content) {
 2124  		if (toolCall.type !== "toolCall") continue;

DIMENSION · MODELCONTEXT

Model & context

7 located findings; each moves from fact to plain language, engineering impact, and source excerpt.

01
L1factmodelContext

01 · 原生 tool calling 之外还有多种 in-band 方言和 Harmony 泄漏修复

SOURCE FACT

loop 支持 glm、hermes、kimi、xml、anthropic、deepseek、harmony、qwen3、gemini、gemma、minimax 方言，在 system/history/stream 三处编码；另检测 GPT-5 Harmony 协议泄漏并尝试恢复 tool call。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

一些本地模型不会说标准函数调用，它会把工具协议写进文本再解析；对模型意外吐出的内部协议也有专门清洗和恢复。

IMPLICATION

小模型/非标准模型兼容面很广，但解析器是额外攻击面和回归矩阵。

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 26–34
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 35–45
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.

02 · 模型目录和协议实现分离，Provider 覆盖极广

SOURCE FACT

catalog 维护 AIML、Alibaba、Bedrock、Anthropic、Azure、Cerebras、Cloudflare、Cursor、DeepSeek、Devin、Fireworks、Copilot、Google、Groq、HF、Kimi、LiteLLM、Moonshot、Ollama、OpenAI 等大量 provider；AI 包实现 Anthropic/OpenAI Responses/Completions/Codex、Gemini/Vertex、Bedrock、Cursor/Devin 等不同 transport。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

模型“有哪些”由目录管理，模型“怎么说话”由协议驱动管理，两者不是一张巨型 if/else。

IMPLICATION

适合作为多模型网关前端，但 catalog 更新、认证和协议正确性必须分开测试。

03 · 流式请求有首事件与空闲双 watchdog，并识别本地工具忙碌

SOURCE FACT

provider wrapper 分别设置 first-item 和 idle timeout；synthetic start 不算真实进展，本地 server-side tool bridge 忙碌时暂停误判，Google CLI 冷推理有独立 5 分钟首事件 floor。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

模型一直没开口和说到一半卡死是两种超时；如果它其实在调用本地工具，不会被错杀。

IMPLICATION

对长思考、多协议和 server-side tools 的可靠性处理很细。

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 181–204
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 205–230
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.

  181  const LAZY_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_ERROR = "Provider stream stalled while waiting for the next event";
  182  const LAZY_STREAM_FIRST_EVENT_TIMEOUT_ERROR = "Provider stream timed out while waiting for the first event";
  183
  184  function hasFinalResult(
  185  	source: AsyncIterable<AssistantMessageEvent>,
  186  ): source is AsyncIterable<AssistantMessageEvent> & { result(): Promise<AssistantMessage> } {
  187  	return typeof (source as { result?: unknown }).result === "function";

  189
  190  /**
  191   * floor used when neither caller option nor env var pins a value. Generic env
  192   * vars (`PI_STREAM_FIRST_EVENT_TIMEOUT_MS`, `PI_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`) still
  193   * take precedence unless a provider opts into OpenAI-family idle flooring for
  194   * local backends that users historically tuned with `PI_OPENAI_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`.
  195   */
  196  interface LazyStreamLimits {
  197  	defaultFirstEventTimeoutMs?: number;
  198  	defaultIdleTimeoutMs?: number;
  199  	/**
  200  	 * The provider implementation already wraps its upstream transport with
  201  	 * stream timeouts. Keep the lazy loader from racing it with generic errors.

L1factmodelContext

04 · 压缩不是单一摘要，而是 context-full/handoff/shake/snapcompact 多策略

SOURCE FACT

CompactionSettings 支持 context-full、handoff、shake、snapcompact、off；默认 reserve 同时取固定值和窗口 15% 的较大者，对小窗口再防止 reserve 不可能；threshold 可按 token 或百分比。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

可以选择传统摘要、交接文档、删除低价值块或 frame 化压缩；预算还会随模型窗口缩放。

IMPLICATION

策略实验空间很大，但同一会话跨模型/策略迁移要处理兼容性。

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 148–167
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 168–189
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.

  205  // ============================================================================
  206  // Token calculation
  207  // ============================================================================
  208
  209  /**
  210   * Calculate total context tokens from usage.
  211   * Uses the native totalTokens field when available, falls back to computing from components.
  212   * Provider-side orchestration tokens are billable but never replay into the
  213   * conversation prefix, so they are excluded from context sizing to keep
  214   * auto-compaction and context-promotion thresholds honest.
  215   */
  216  export function calculateContextTokens(usage: Usage): number {
  217  	const orchestration = usage.orchestration;
  218  	const orchestrationTotal = orchestration
  219  		? (orchestration.input ?? 0) + (orchestration.output ?? 0) + (orchestration.cacheRead ?? 0)
  220  		: 0;
  221  	const raw = usage.totalTokens || usage.input + usage.output + usage.cacheRead + usage.cacheWrite;
  222  	return Math.max(0, raw - orchestrationTotal);
  223  }
  224
  225  export function calculatePromptTokens(usage: Usage): number {
  226  	const promptTokens = usage.input + usage.cacheRead + usage.cacheWrite;
  227  	if (promptTokens > 0) {
  228  		return promptTokens;
  229  	}
  230  	return calculateContextTokens(usage);
  231  }
  232
  233  /**
  234   * Get usage from an assistant message if available.
  235   * Skips aborted and error messages as they don't have valid usage data.
  236   */
  237  function getAssistantUsage(msg: AgentMessage): Usage | undefined {
  238  	if (msg.role === "assistant" && "usage" in msg) {
  239  		const assistantMsg = msg as AssistantMessage;
  240  		if (assistantMsg.stopReason !== "aborted" && assistantMsg.stopReason !== "error" && assistantMsg.usage) {
  241  			return assistantMsg.usage;
  242  		}
  243  	}
  244  	return undefined;
  245  }
  246
  247  /**
  248   * Find the last non-aborted assistant message usage from session entries.
  249   */
  250  export function getLastAssistantUsage(entries: SessionEntry[]): Usage | undefined {
  251  	for (let i = entries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
  252  		const entry = entries[i];
  253  		if (entry.type === "message") {
  254  			const usage = getAssistantUsage(entry.message);
  255  			if (usage) return usage;
  256  		}
  257  	}
  258  	return undefined;
  259  }

  235  /**
  236   * Calculate total context tokens from usage.
  237   * Prefers an explicit provider-reported context occupancy when available.
  238   * Otherwise uses totalTokens and falls back to computing from billable
  239   * components. Provider-side orchestration tokens are billable but never replay
  240   * into the conversation prefix, so they are excluded from context sizing.
  241   */
  242  export function calculateContextTokens(usage: Usage): number {
  243  	if (usage.contextTokens !== undefined) {
  244  		return Math.max(0, usage.contextTokens);
  245  	}
  246  	const orchestration = usage.orchestration;
  247  	const orchestrationTotal = orchestration
  248  		? (orchestration.input ?? 0) + (orchestration.output ?? 0) + (orchestration.cacheRead ?? 0)
  249  		: 0;
  250  	const raw = usage.totalTokens || usage.input + usage.output + usage.cacheRead + usage.cacheWrite;
  251  	return Math.max(0, raw - orchestrationTotal);
  252  }
  253
  254  export function calculatePromptTokens(usage: Usage): number {
  255  	if (usage.contextTokens !== undefined) {
  256  		return Math.max(0, usage.contextTokens);
  257  	}
  258  	const promptTokens = usage.input + usage.cacheRead + usage.cacheWrite;
  259  	if (promptTokens > 0) {
  260  		return promptTokens;

06 · 工具输出还有独立 prune/protection/shake 层

SOURCE FACT

pruning 可清除已消费和被更新结果，tool-protection 保护关键工具/最近预算；shake 依据角色、工具类型、错误/无用标志和 token 权重删除低价值块，并主动失效消息 token cache。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

不是等整本对话太厚才总结，旧日志、重复读取和明确无用结果会先做局部瘦身；关键结果和最近工作有保护圈。

IMPLICATION

上下文治理覆盖工具层，但启发式误删需用回归样本监控。

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

    8  import type { SessionEntry, SessionMessageEntry } from "./entries";
    9  import { invalidateMessageCache } from "./message-cache";
   10  import {
   11  	collectToolCallsById,
   12  	isProtectedToolResult,
   13  	isSkillReadToolResult,
   14  	type ProtectedToolMatcher,
   15  } from "./tool-protection";
   16  import { splitReadSelector } from "./utils";
   17
   18  export interface PruneConfig {
   19  	/** Keep the most recent tool output tokens intact. */
   20  	protectTokens: number;
   21  	/** Only prune if total savings meets this threshold. */
   22  	minimumSavings: number;
   23  	/** Tool-result protection matchers. String entries protect every result from that tool; predicates may inspect the paired tool call. */
   24  	protectedTools: ProtectedToolMatcher[];
   25  	/**
   26  	 * Optional supersede key function (see {@link SupersedePruneConfig.supersedeKey}).
   27  	 * When provided, superseded tool results are pruned first — even inside the
   28  	 * `protectTokens` window — before age-based victims. Absent, behavior is
   29  	 * unchanged.
   30  	 */
   31  	supersedeKey?: SupersedeKeyFn;
   32  	/** Useless-flagged results bypass the protect window (see {@link USELESS_NOTICE}). Default true. */
   33  	pruneUseless?: boolean;
   34  	/**
   35  	 * Compaction boundary: the `firstKeptEntryId` of the latest compaction on
   36  	 * the branch. Entries at indices BEFORE this id are summarized away and never
   37  	 * sent to the model, so mutating them only churns persisted history without
   38  	 * shrinking the prompt — they are skipped. Undefined = no compaction (the
   39  	 * whole branch is sent).
   40  	 */
   41  	keepBoundaryId?: string;
   42  	/**
   43  	 * Prompt-cache guard. When set, a tool result whose all-message suffix
   44  	 * (tokens of every message after it) EXCEEDS this is part of the warm,
   45  	 * already-sent cache prefix: mutating it forces the provider to re-write the
   46  	 * whole suffix (cacheWrite premium). Such results — including superseded and
   47  	 * useless ones, which otherwise bypass {@link protectTokens} — are left for
   48  	 * compaction/shake (which rebuild the cache anyway) to reclaim. Undefined =
   49  	 * no cache guard (legacy: superseded/useless prune at any depth).
   50  	 */
   51  	cacheWarmSuffixTokens?: number;
   52  }
   53
   54  export const DEFAULT_PRUNE_CONFIG: PruneConfig = {
   55  	protectTokens: 40_000,
   56  	minimumSavings: 20_000,
   57  	protectedTools: ["skill", isSkillReadToolResult],
   58  	pruneUseless: true,
   59  };
   60
   61  export interface PruneResult {
   62  	prunedCount: number;
   63  	tokensSaved: number;
   64  }
   65
   66  /** Exact placeholder written over a superseded tool result. */
   67  export const SUPERSEDED_NOTICE = "[Superseded by a newer read of this file]";
   68
   69  /** Exact placeholder written over an elided useless tool result. */
   70  export const USELESS_NOTICE = "[Uneventful result elided]";
   71
   72  /**
   73   * Maps a tool call to a supersede key. Results sharing a key form a group in
   74   * which every result except the newest is a supersede candidate. A key `K`
   75   * additionally supersedes keys with prefix `K + "\u0000"` (selector-free read
   76   * supersedes selector-carrying reads of the same base path). Return
   77   * `undefined` to exempt a call from supersede grouping.
   78   */
   79  export type SupersedeKeyFn = (toolName: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => string | undefined;
   80
   81  export interface SupersedePruneConfig {
   82  	/** Supersede key function; results sharing a key supersede older ones. */
   83  	supersedeKey?: SupersedeKeyFn;
   84  	/** Also prune results flagged useless by their tool. Default false. */
   85  	pruneUseless?: boolean;
   86  	/** Prune a candidate now when all messages after it total at most this many estimated tokens. Default 8 000. */
   87  	suffixTokenLimit?: number;
   88  	/**
   89  	 * Prune all candidates when the last message is at least this old: the
   90  	 * provider prompt cache is then cold, so re-writing it is free. MUST exceed
   91  	 * the cache retention (Anthropic "long" = 1h) or a still-warm prefix is busted
   92  	 * by the flush. Default 30 min — callers on long retention override it.
   93  	 */
   94  	idleFlushMs?: number;
   95  	/** Clock override for tests. */
   96  	now?: number;
   97  	/**
   98  	 * Compaction boundary (`firstKeptEntryId` of the latest compaction). Entries
   99  	 * before it are summarized away and never sent, so they are skipped in every
  100  	 * path — including the idle flush — to avoid pointless history churn.
  101  	 * Undefined = no compaction (the whole branch is sent).
  102  	 */
  103  	keepBoundaryId?: string;
  104  	/** Tool-result protection matchers (same contract as {@link PruneConfig.protectedTools}). */
  105  	protectedTools: ProtectedToolMatcher[];
  106  }
  107
  108  const DEFAULT_SUFFIX_TOKEN_LIMIT = 8_000;
  109  const DEFAULT_IDLE_FLUSH_MS = 30 * 60_000;
  110
  111  function createPrunedNotice(tokens: number): string {
  112  	return `[Output truncated - ${tokens} tokens]`;
  113  }
  114
  115  /**
  116   * Generic age-based pruning floor. Below this, blanking a result to
  117   * `[Output truncated - N tokens]` recovers nothing — the placeholder itself
  118   * costs ~8 tokens, so a sub-floor result grows the context (and churns the
  119   * prompt cache) instead of shrinking it. Superseded/useless results keep their
  120   * own rules: useless already drops no-savings candidates, superseded prunes for
  121   * correctness regardless of size.
  122   */
  123  const MIN_PRUNE_TOKENS = 50;
  124
  125  function getToolResultMessage(entry: SessionEntry): ToolResultMessage | undefined {
  126  	if (entry.type !== "message") return undefined;
  127  	const message = entry.message as AgentMessage;
  128  	if (message.role !== "toolResult") return undefined;
  129  	return message as ToolResultMessage;
  130  }
  131
  132  function estimatePrunedSavings(tokens: number, notice: string): number {
  133  	const noticeTokens = Math.ceil(notice.length / 4);
  134  	return Math.max(0, tokens - noticeTokens);
  135  }
  136
  137  /**
  138   * For each entry index, the estimated token total of all *message* entries
  139   * strictly after it — how much prompt-cache content the provider must re-write
  140   * (cacheWrite premium) if that entry is mutated in place. Used to keep prune
  141   * mutations inside the cheap-to-recache tail.
  142   */
  143  function computeMessageSuffixTokens(entries: readonly SessionEntry[]): number[] {
  144  	const suffix = new Array<number>(entries.length);
  145  	let accumulated = 0;
  146  	for (let i = entries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
  147  		suffix[i] = accumulated;
  148  		const entry = entries[i];
  149  		if (entry.type === "message") accumulated += estimateTokens(entry.message as AgentMessage);
  150  	}
  151  	return suffix;
  152  }
  153
  154  /**
  155   * Resolve the array index of the compaction boundary (`keepBoundaryId`). Entries
  156   * before this index are summarized away by the latest compaction and never sent,
  157   * so prune passes must not mutate them. Returns 0 when there is no boundary (no
  158   * compaction → whole branch is sent) or the id is absent from `entries`.
  159   */
  160  function resolveBoundaryIndex(entries: readonly SessionEntry[], keepBoundaryId: string | undefined): number {
  161  	if (keepBoundaryId === undefined) return 0;
  162  	const index = entries.findIndex(entry => entry.id === keepBoundaryId);
  163  	return index < 0 ? 0 : index;
  164  }
  165
  166  interface SupersedeCandidate {
  167  	entry: SessionMessageEntry;
  168  	message: ToolResultMessage;
  169  	/** Index of the entry within the `entries` array. */
  170  	index: number;
  171  	tokens: number;
  172  	/** Placeholder text written over the blanked result. */
  173  	notice: string;
  174  }
  175
  176  /**
  177   * Collect superseded tool results: for every unpruned, unprotected tool result
  178   * whose paired call resolves a supersede key, a LATER result with the same key
  179   * — or with a key that is the `"\u0000"`-prefix parent of this one — marks it
  180   * superseded. Returned in message order.
  181   */
  182  function collectSupersededResults(
  183  	entries: readonly SessionEntry[],
  184  	toolCallsById: ReadonlyMap<string, AgentToolCall>,
  185  	supersedeKey: SupersedeKeyFn,
  186  	protectedTools: readonly ProtectedToolMatcher[],
  187  ): SupersedeCandidate[] {
  188  	const candidates: SupersedeCandidate[] = [];
  189  	const seenKeys = new Set<string>();
  190  	for (let i = entries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
  191  		const entry = entries[i];
  192  		const message = getToolResultMessage(entry);
  193  		if (!message || message.prunedAt !== undefined) continue;
  194  		const toolCall = toolCallsById.get(message.toolCallId);
  195  		if (!toolCall) continue;
  196  		if (isProtectedToolResult(message, toolCall, protectedTools)) continue;
  197  		const key = supersedeKey(toolCall.name, toolCall.arguments as Record<string, unknown>);
  198  		if (key === undefined) continue;
  199  		const separator = key.indexOf("\u0000");
  200  		const superseded = seenKeys.has(key) || (separator >= 0 && seenKeys.has(key.slice(0, separator)));
  201  		seenKeys.add(key);
  202  		if (!superseded) continue;
  203  		candidates.push({
  204  			entry: entry as SessionMessageEntry,
  205  			message,
  206  			index: i,
  207  			tokens: estimateTokens(message as AgentMessage),
  208  			notice: SUPERSEDED_NOTICE,
  209  		});
  210  	}
  211  	return candidates.reverse();
  212  }
  213
  214  /**
  215   * Collect tool results their tool flagged contextually useless (zero matches,
  216   * elapsed wait): unpruned, non-error, unprotected, not in `exclude`, and large
  217   * enough that blanking to {@link USELESS_NOTICE} actually saves tokens.
  218   * Returned in message order.
  219   */
  220  function collectUselessResults(
  221  	entries: readonly SessionEntry[],
  222  	toolCallsById: ReadonlyMap<string, AgentToolCall>,
  223  	protectedTools: readonly ProtectedToolMatcher[],
  224  	exclude: ReadonlySet<ToolResultMessage>,
  225  ): SupersedeCandidate[] {
  226  	const candidates: SupersedeCandidate[] = [];
  227  	for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
  228  		const entry = entries[i];
  229  		const message = getToolResultMessage(entry);
  230  		if (message?.useless !== true || message.prunedAt !== undefined || message.isError === true) continue;
  231  		if (exclude.has(message)) continue;
  232  		if (isProtectedToolResult(message, toolCallsById.get(message.toolCallId), protectedTools)) continue;
  233  		const tokens = estimateTokens(message as AgentMessage);
  234  		if (estimatePrunedSavings(tokens, USELESS_NOTICE) <= 0) continue;
  235  		candidates.push({ entry: entry as SessionMessageEntry, message, index: i, tokens, notice: USELESS_NOTICE });
  236  	}
  237  	return candidates;
  238  }
  239
  240  /**
  241   * Prune superseded tool results (e.g. stale `read` outputs replaced by a newer
  242   * read of the same file) and, when `pruneUseless` is set, results their tool
  243   * flagged contextually useless. Cheap, incremental, and prompt-cache-aware: a
  244   * candidate is pruned now only when the suffix after it is small (tail case —
  245   * the read→edit→read loop) or when the context has been idle long enough that
  246   * the provider cache is cold anyway (then all still-sent candidates flush).
  247   * Never mutates entries before `keepBoundaryId` (summarized away — not sent).
  248   */
  249  export function pruneSupersededToolResults(entries: SessionEntry[], config: SupersedePruneConfig): PruneResult {
  250  	const toolCallsById = collectToolCallsById(entries);
  251  	const candidates = config.supersedeKey
  252  		? collectSupersededResults(entries, toolCallsById, config.supersedeKey, config.protectedTools)
  253  		: [];
  254  	if (config.pruneUseless) {
  255  		const exclude = new Set(candidates.map(candidate => candidate.message));
  256  		candidates.push(...collectUselessResults(entries, toolCallsById, config.protectedTools, exclude));
  257  		candidates.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
  258  	}
  259  	if (candidates.length === 0) return { prunedCount: 0, tokensSaved: 0 };
  260
  261  	const now = config.now ?? Date.now();
  262  	let lastMessageTimestamp: number | undefined;
  263  	for (let i = entries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
  264  		const entry = entries[i];
  265  		if (entry.type !== "message") continue;
  266  		const timestamp = (entry.message as AgentMessage).timestamp;
  267  		if (typeof timestamp === "number") lastMessageTimestamp = timestamp;
  268  		break;
  269  	}
  270  	const idle =
  271  		lastMessageTimestamp !== undefined && now - lastMessageTimestamp >= (config.idleFlushMs ?? DEFAULT_IDLE_FLUSH_MS);
  272
  273  	const boundaryIndex = resolveBoundaryIndex(entries, config.keepBoundaryId);
  274
  275  	let toPrune: SupersedeCandidate[];
  276  	if (idle) {
  277  		// Provider cache is cold (idle exceeds the retention TTL), so re-writing
  278  		// the sent region costs nothing. Entries before the compaction boundary
  279  		// are summarized away and never sent — skip them to avoid pointless churn.
  280  		toPrune = candidates.filter(candidate => candidate.index >= boundaryIndex);
  281  	} else {
  282  		const suffixTokenLimit = config.suffixTokenLimit ?? DEFAULT_SUFFIX_TOKEN_LIMIT;
  283  		// suffixTokens[i] = estimated tokens of all messages strictly after entry i.
  284  		// Mutating a candidate re-writes its suffix in the warm cache, so prune only
  285  		// when that suffix is small (cheap-to-recache tail) and the candidate sits
  286  		// at/after the compaction boundary.
  287  		const suffixTokens = computeMessageSuffixTokens(entries);
  288  		toPrune = candidates.filter(
  289  			candidate => candidate.index >= boundaryIndex && suffixTokens[candidate.index] <= suffixTokenLimit,
  290  		);
  291  	}
  292  	if (toPrune.length === 0) return { prunedCount: 0, tokensSaved: 0 };
  293
  294  	const prunedAt = Date.now();
  295  	let tokensSaved = 0;
  296  	for (const candidate of toPrune) {
  297  		candidate.message.content = [{ type: "text", text: candidate.notice }];
  298  		candidate.message.prunedAt = prunedAt;
  299  		invalidateMessageCache(candidate.message as AgentMessage);
  300  		tokensSaved += estimatePrunedSavings(candidate.tokens, candidate.notice);
  301  	}
  302  	return { prunedCount: toPrune.length, tokensSaved };
  303  }
  304
  305  export function pruneToolOutputs(entries: SessionEntry[], config: PruneConfig = DEFAULT_PRUNE_CONFIG): PruneResult {
  306  	let accumulatedTokens = 0;
  307  	let tokensSaved = 0;
  308  	let prunedCount = 0;
  309
  310  	const candidates: Array<{ entry: SessionMessageEntry; tokens: number; superseded: boolean; useless: boolean }> = [];
  311  	const toolCallsById = collectToolCallsById(entries);
  312  	const supersededMessages = config.supersedeKey
  313  		? new Set(
  314  				collectSupersededResults(entries, toolCallsById, config.supersedeKey, config.protectedTools).map(
  315  					candidate => candidate.message,
  316  				),
  317  			)
  318  		: undefined;
  319  	const uselessMessages =
  320  		config.pruneUseless !== false
  321  			? new Set(
  322  					collectUselessResults(
  323  						entries,
  324  						toolCallsById,
  325  						config.protectedTools,
  326  						supersededMessages ?? new Set(),
  327  					).map(candidate => candidate.message),
  328  				)
  329  			: undefined;
  330
  331  	const boundaryIndex = resolveBoundaryIndex(entries, config.keepBoundaryId);

SOURCE FACT

runtime 以 memory.backend 为唯一选择器；local 将 rollout 摘要写 SQLite/markdown 且 learned.md 可写但不可结构化搜索，Mnemopi 是本地 SQLite+embedding+实体/三元组/时间/召回/整合管线，Hindsight 为远端后端。主 session 才启动并动态刷新 memory tools/system prompt。

IMPLICATION

上下文和长期记忆分层清楚，但多后端的隐私、成本与一致性需要治理。

02 · Approval 分级完整，但默认是 yolo

SOURCE FACT

工具声明 read/write/exec tier 和可按参数计算的 policy；user per-tool allow/prompt/deny 高优先级。always-ask 只自动 read，write 自动 read+write，yolo 自动所有 tier；settings 默认 tools.approvalMode=yolo。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

门卫机制很成熟，但默认把门敞开；用户不改设置时，bash、browser、task 等执行级工具通常不询问。

IMPLICATION

面向个人效率是合理选择，企业默认策略应反转为 write 或 always-ask。

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 13–25
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 26–39
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.

   13  export type ApprovalPolicy = "allow" | "deny" | "prompt";
   14  export type ApprovalMode = "always-ask" | "write" | "yolo";

   18  export interface ResolvedApproval {
   19  	policy: ApprovalPolicy;
   20  	tier: ToolTier;
   21  	reason?: string;
   22  	override: boolean;
   23  	source?: "tool" | "user" | "mode";
   24  }
   25
   26  const POLICY_VALUES: ReadonlySet<ApprovalPolicy> = new Set(["allow", "deny", "prompt"]);
   27  const TIER_VALUES: ReadonlySet<ToolTier> = new Set(["read", "write", "exec"]);
   28
   29  const TIER_RANK: Record<ToolTier, number> = {
   30  	read: 0,
   31  	write: 1,
   32  	exec: 2,
   33  };
   34
   35  const APPROVAL_MODE_MAX_TIER: Record<ApprovalMode, ToolTier> = {
   36  	"always-ask": "read",
   37  	write: "write",
   38  	yolo: "exec",
   39  };
   40
   41  const DEFAULT_PROMPT_TRUNCATE_CHARS = 2000;
   42
   43  /** Best-effort conversion of an arbitrary user-supplied value to a policy. */
   44  function normalizePolicy(value: unknown): ApprovalPolicy | undefined {
   45  	if (typeof value !== "string") return undefined;
   46  	const lowered = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   47  	return POLICY_VALUES.has(lowered as ApprovalPolicy) ? (lowered as ApprovalPolicy) : undefined;
   48  }
   49
   50  function isToolTier(value: unknown): value is ToolTier {
   51  	return typeof value === "string" && TIER_VALUES.has(value as ToolTier);
   52  }
   53
   54  function normalizeDecision(value: unknown): Omit<ResolvedApproval, "policy"> & { policy?: ApprovalPolicy } {
   55  	if (isToolTier(value)) {
   56  		return { tier: value, override: false };
   57  	}
   58
   59  	if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)) {
   60  		const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
   61  		const tier = isToolTier(record.tier) ? record.tier : "exec";
   62  		const reason = typeof record.reason === "string" && record.reason.length > 0 ? record.reason : undefined;
   63  		const policy = normalizePolicy(record.policy);
   64  		return {
   65  			tier,
   66  			override: record.override === true,
   67  			...(policy ? { policy } : {}),
   68  			...(reason ? { reason } : {}),
   69  		};
   70  	}
   71
   72  	return { tier: "exec", override: false };
   73  }
   74
   75  function getToolDecision(
   76  	tool: ApprovalSubject,
   77  	args: unknown,
   78  ): Omit<ResolvedApproval, "policy"> & { policy?: ApprovalPolicy } {
   79  	const approval = tool.approval;
   80  	const decision: ToolApprovalDecision | undefined = typeof approval === "function" ? approval(args) : approval;
   81  	return normalizeDecision(decision);
   82  }
   83
   84  /**
   85   * Evaluate a tool's own approval declaration against `args` and return the
   86   * resulting capability tier, defaulting to `exec` when the tool omits an
   87   * approval. Unlike reading `tool.approval` directly, this runs function-valued
   88   * approvals — the write tool's `xd://` gate uses it to take a mounted device's
   89   * argument-dependent tier instead of falling back to `exec`.
   90   */
   91  export function resolveToolTier(tool: ApprovalSubject, args: unknown): ToolTier {
   92  	return getToolDecision(tool, args).tier;
   93  }
   94
   95  function modeApprovesTier(mode: ApprovalMode, tier: ToolTier): boolean {
   96  	return TIER_RANK[tier] <= TIER_RANK[APPROVAL_MODE_MAX_TIER[mode]];
   97  }

   93   * approvals — the write tool's `xd://` gate uses it to take a mounted device's
   94   * argument-dependent tier instead of falling back to `exec`.
   95   */
   96  export function resolveToolTier(tool: ApprovalSubject, args: unknown): ToolTier {
   97  	return getToolDecision(tool, args).tier;
   98  }
   99
  100  function modeApprovesTier(mode: ApprovalMode, tier: ToolTier): boolean {
  101  	return TIER_RANK[tier] <= TIER_RANK[APPROVAL_MODE_MAX_TIER[mode]];
  102  }

03 · 主 Agent 默认宿主执行；子任务 isolation 默认 none 且主要隔离工作区

SOURCE FACT

bash runner 使用宿主 shell/native process；源码未给主 Agent 建容器/namespace sandbox。task isolation 可选 APFS/btrfs/ZFS/reflink/overlayfs/ProjFS/block clone/worktree/copy，并用 patch 或 branch 合并，但默认 mode=none。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

子工人可以拿一份独立项目副本，防止同时改乱代码；这不自动隔离网络、进程和主机秘密，而且默认连副本也不开。

IMPLICATION

工作区隔离与安全沙箱必须分开标注；无人值守仍需外层 VM/container。

L1factconnectors

01 · MCP 是完整内建连接器，不是插件样例

SOURCE FACT

MCPManager 从多来源配置发现服务器，并行连接、缓存 tools、订阅 resources、接收 notifications、动态刷新；transport 支持 stdio、legacy SSE、Streamable HTTP，HTTP 保存 session id、处理 server request/notification、401/403 刷新后重试。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

它不仅能调用 MCP 工具，还管理连接、认证、资源订阅、服务端推送和重连生命周期。

IMPLICATION

连接器成熟度高，适合企业工具生态；同时需审计远端 URL、headers 和本地 command 配置。

  419  						this.#handleServerNotification(name, method, params);
  420  					},
  421  					onRequest: (method, params) => {
  422  						return this.#handleServerRequest(method, params);
  423  					},
  424  				});
  425  			})().then(
  426  				connection => {
  427  					// Store original config (without resolved tokens) to keep
  428  					// cache keys stable and avoid leaking rotating credentials.
  429  					connection.config = config;
  430  					this.#serverConfigs.set(name, config);
  431  					if (sources[name]) {
  432  						connection._source = sources[name];
  433  					}
  434  					if (this.#pendingConnections.get(name) === connectionPromise) {
  435  						this.#pendingConnections.delete(name);
  436  						this.#connections.set(name, connection);
  437  					}
  438
  439  					// Wire auth refresh for HTTP-like transports so 401s trigger token refresh.
  440  					// Gate on a resolvable managed credential, not on the auth block:
  441  					// definition-only configs (url-keyed fallback) get Bearer injection
  442  					// too and need the same mid-session refresh hook.
  443  					if (
  444  						isAuthRefreshableMCPTransport(connection.transport) &&
  445  						lookupMcpOAuthCredential(this.#authStorage, config)
  446  					) {
  447  						connection.transport.onAuthError = async () => {
  448  							const refreshed = await this.#resolveAuthConfig(config, { forceRefresh: true });
  449  							if (refreshed.type === "http" || refreshed.type === "sse") {
  450  								return refreshed.headers ?? null;
  451  							}

  326  	#subscribeAndTrack(name: string, connection: MCPServerConnection, uris: string[], notificationEpoch: number): void {
  327  		void subscribeToResources(connection, uris)
  328  			.then(() => {
  329  				const action = resolveSubscriptionPostAction(
  330  					this.#notificationsEnabled,
  331  					this.#notificationsEpoch,
  332  					notificationEpoch,
  333  				);
  334  				if (action === "rollback") {
  335  					void unsubscribeFromResources(connection, uris).catch(error => {
  336  						logger.debug("Failed to rollback stale MCP resource subscription", {
  337  							path: `mcp:${name}`,
  338  							error,
  339  						});
  340  					});
  341  					return;
  342  				}
  343  				if (action === "ignore") {
  344  					return;
  345  				}
  346  				this.#subscribedResources.set(name, new Set(uris));
  347  			})
  348  			.catch(error => {
  349  				logger.debug("Failed to subscribe to MCP resources", { path: `mcp:${name}`, error });
  350  			});
  351  	}
  352
  353  	setNotificationsEnabled(enabled: boolean): void {
  354  		const wasEnabled = this.#notificationsEnabled;
  355  		this.#notificationsEnabled = enabled;
  356  		if (enabled === wasEnabled) return;
  357
  358  		this.#notificationsEpoch += 1;
  359  		const notificationEpoch = this.#notificationsEpoch;
  360
  361  		if (enabled) {
  362  			// Subscribe to all connected servers that support it
  363  			for (const [name, connection] of this.#connections) {
  364  				if (connection.capabilities.resources?.subscribe && connection.resources) {
  365  					const uris = connection.resources.map(r => r.uri);
  366  					this.#subscribeAndTrack(name, connection, uris, notificationEpoch);
  367  				}
  368  			}
  369  			return;
  370  		}
  371
  372  		// Unsubscribe from all servers
  373  		for (const [name, connection] of this.#connections) {
  374  			const uris = this.#subscribedResources.get(name);
  375  			if (uris && uris.size > 0) {
  376  				void unsubscribeFromResources(connection, Array.from(uris)).catch(error => {
  377  					logger.debug("Failed to unsubscribe MCP resources", { path: `mcp:${name}`, error });
  378  				});
  379  			}
  380  		}
  381  		this.#subscribedResources.clear();
  382  	}

02 · 可直接吸收 Claude、Gemini、OpenCode 等生态的 MCP 配置

SOURCE FACT

capability discovery providers 解析本产品、Claude、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Codex、Cline、Cursor、VSCode/Windsurf 等配置；OpenCode local/remote 和 Gemini mcpServers 被归一成同一 stdio/SSE/HTTP contract，并保留 source metadata。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

用户换工具时不必手工重写全部 MCP 配置，OMP 会读取其他 Agent 的配置并统一格式。

IMPLICATION

迁移体验突出，但跨生态自动加载需有来源可见性和项目 trust。

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 88–126
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 127–167
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.

  130  		const args = configuredArgs ? [...commandArgs, ...configuredArgs] : commandArgs;

  143  async function loadMCPServers(ctx: LoadContext): Promise<LoadResult<MCPServer>> {
  144  	const items: MCPServer[] = [];
  145  	const warnings: string[] = [];
  146
  147  	// User-level: ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
  148  	const userConfigPath = getUserPath(ctx, "opencode", "opencode.json");
  149  	if (userConfigPath) {
  150  		const config = await loadJsonConfig(userConfigPath);
  151  		if (config) {
  152  			const result = extractMCPServers(config, userConfigPath, "user");
  153  			items.push(...result.items);
  154  			if (result.warnings) warnings.push(...result.warnings);
  155  		}
  156  	}
  157
  158  	// Project-level: opencode.json in project root
  159  	const projectConfigPath = path.join(ctx.cwd, "opencode.json");
  160  	const projectConfig = await loadJsonConfig(projectConfigPath);
  161  	if (projectConfig) {
  162  		const result = extractMCPServers(projectConfig, projectConfigPath, "project");
  163  		items.push(...result.items);
  164  		if (result.warnings) warnings.push(...result.warnings);
  165  	}
  166
  167  	return { items, warnings };
  168  }
  169
  170  function extractMCPServers(
  171  	config: Record<string, unknown>,
  172  	configPath: string,
  173  	level: "user" | "project",
  174  ): LoadResult<MCPServer> {
  175  	const items: MCPServer[] = [];
  176  	const warnings: string[] = [];
  177
  178  	if (!config.mcp || typeof config.mcp !== "object") {
  179  		return { items, warnings };
  180  	}
  181
  182  	const servers = expandEnvVarsDeep(config.mcp as Record<string, unknown>);
  183
  184  	for (const [name, raw] of Object.entries(servers)) {
  185  		if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") {
  186  			warnings.push(`Invalid MCP config for "${name}" in ${configPath}`);
  187  			continue;
  188  		}
  189
  190  		const serverConfig = raw as OpenCodeMCPConfig;
  191
  192  		// Determine transport from OpenCode's "type" field
  193  		let transport: "stdio" | "sse" | "http" | undefined;
  194  		if (serverConfig.type === "local") {
  195  			transport = "stdio";
  196  		} else if (serverConfig.type === "remote") {
  197  			transport = "http";
  198  		} else if (serverConfig.url) {
  199  			transport = "http";
  200  		} else if (serverConfig.command) {
  201  			transport = "stdio";
  202  		}
  203
  204  		const command = normalizeCommand(serverConfig.command, serverConfig.args);
  205  		const env = stringRecord(serverConfig.environment) ?? stringRecord(serverConfig.env);
  206
  207  		items.push({
  208  			name,
  209  			command: command.command,
  210  			args: command.args,
  211  			env,
  212  			url: typeof serverConfig.url === "string" ? serverConfig.url : undefined,
  213  			headers: serverConfig.headers && typeof serverConfig.headers === "object" ? serverConfig.headers : undefined,
  214  			enabled: serverConfig.enabled,
  215  			timeout: typeof serverConfig.timeout === "number" ? serverConfig.timeout : undefined,
  216  			transport,
  217  			_source: createSourceMeta(PROVIDER_ID, configPath, level),
  218  		});
  219  	}
  220
  221  	return { items, warnings };
  222  }

  188  	const warnings: string[] = [];
  189
  190  	// Deep-merge each server across config layers in ascending precedence, the
  191  	// way OpenCode itself merges configs, so a partial higher-precedence override
  192  	// (e.g. project opencode.jsonc setting only mcp.<name>.timeout) inherits the
  193  	// command/url from lower-precedence layers instead of shadowing the complete
  194  	// definition and being rejected by mcpCapability.validate.
  195  	const mergedByName = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
  196  	const sourceByName = new Map<string, OpenCodeConfigSource>();
  197
  198  	for (const source of getConfigSources(ctx)) {
  199  		const config = await loadJsonConfig(source.path, configPath => {
  200  			logger.warn("Failed to parse OpenCode config", { path: configPath });
  201  		});
  202  		if (!config || !isRecord(config.mcp)) continue;
  203
  204  		for (const name in config.mcp) {
  205  			const raw = config.mcp[name];
  206  			if (!isRecord(raw)) {
  207  				warnings.push(`Invalid MCP config for "${name}" in ${source.path}`);
  208  				continue;
  209  			}
  210  			const previous = mergedByName.get(name);
  211  			mergedByName.set(name, previous ? mergeConfigRecords(previous, raw) : raw);
  212  			sourceByName.set(name, source);
  213  		}
  214  	}
  215
  216  	const items: MCPServer[] = [];
  217  	for (const [name, config] of mergedByName) {
  218  		const serverConfig = expandEnvVarsDeep(config) as OpenCodeMCPConfig;
  219  		const source = sourceByName.get(name)!;
  220  		items.push(buildMCPServer(name, serverConfig, source));
  221  	}
  222
  223  	return { items, warnings };
  224  }
  225
  226  /** Deep-merge two OpenCode config records; `override` wins, nested records recurse. */
  227  function mergeConfigRecords(base: Record<string, unknown>, override: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
  228  	const result: Record<string, unknown> = { ...base };
  229  	for (const key in override) {
  230  		const value = override[key];
  231  		const existing = result[key];
  232  		result[key] = isRecord(existing) && isRecord(value) ? mergeConfigRecords(existing, value) : value;
  233  	}
  234  	return result;
  235  }
  236
  237  /** Translate one merged OpenCode MCP entry into the canonical MCPServer shape. */
  238  function buildMCPServer(name: string, serverConfig: OpenCodeMCPConfig, source: OpenCodeConfigSource): MCPServer {

Observability & replay

2 located findings; each moves from fact to plain language, engineering impact, and source excerpt.

01
L1factobservability

01 · 会话是树形事件账本，存储层可替换

SOURCE FACT

SessionManager 保留 parentId 树、message/compaction/branch/model/thinking/custom/session_init 等 entry；storage contract 支持 append/read/list/lock，仓库实现 indexed local、SQL、Redis 等后端并把大对象放 blob/artifact store。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

聊天、分支、压缩和配置变化都作为事件保存；存哪里可以从个人本地换到服务端数据库。

IMPLICATION

同一 Harness 可从 CLI 扩到多用户服务，但多后端一致性/锁/迁移成为核心基础设施。

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 1–129
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 130–260
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.

   79  // FinalizationRegistry to clean up leaked file descriptors
   80  const writerRegistry = new FinalizationRegistry<number>(fd => {

   88  class FileSessionStorageWriter implements SessionStorageWriter {
   89  	#fd: number;
   90  	#closed = false;
   91  	#error: Error | undefined;
   92  	#onError: ((err: Error) => void) | undefined;
   93
   94  	constructor(fpath: string, options?: { flags?: "a" | "w"; onError?: (err: Error) => void }) {
   95  		this.#onError = options?.onError;
   96  		const flags = options?.flags ?? "a";
   97  		// Ensure parent directory exists
   98  		const dir = path.dirname(fpath);
   99  		if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
  100  			fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  101  		}
  102  		// Open file once, keep fd for lifetime
  103  		this.#fd = fs.openSync(fpath, flags === "w" ? "w" : "a");
  104  		// Register for cleanup if abandoned without close()
  105  		writerRegistry.register(this, this.#fd, this);
  106  	}
  107
  108  	#recordError(err: unknown): Error {
  109  		const error = toError(err);
  110  		if (!this.#error) this.#error = error;
  111  		this.#onError?.(error);
  112  		return error;
  113  	}
  114
  115  	async append(line: string): Promise<void> {
  116  		if (this.#closed) throw new Error("Writer closed");
  117  		if (this.#error) throw this.#error;
  118  		try {
  119  			const buf = Buffer.from(line, "utf-8");
  120  			let offset = 0;
  121  			while (offset < buf.length) {
  122  				const written = fs.writeSync(this.#fd, buf, offset, buf.length - offset);
  123  				if (written === 0) {
  124  					throw new Error("Short write");
  125  				}
  126  				offset += written;
  127  			}
  128  		} catch (err) {
  129  			throw this.#recordError(err);
  130  		}
  131  	}
  132
  133  	async flush(): Promise<void> {
  134  		if (this.#error) throw this.#error;
  135  	}
  136
  137  	isOpen(): boolean {
  138  		return !this.#closed;
  139  	}
  140
  141  	async close(): Promise<void> {
  142  		if (this.#closed) return;
  143  		this.#closed = true;
  144  		// Unregister from finalization - we're closing properly
  145  		writerRegistry.unregister(this);
  146  		try {
  147  			fs.closeSync(this.#fd);
  148  		} catch {
  149  			// Ignore close errors
  150  		}
  151  	}
  152
  153  	getError(): Error | undefined {
  154  		return this.#error;
  155  	}
  156  }

  158  export class FileSessionStorage implements SessionStorage {
  159  	ensureDirSync(dir: string): void {
  160  		if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
  161  			fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  162  		}
  163  	}
  164
  165  	existsSync(path: string): boolean {

  169  	writeTextSync(fpath: string, content: string): void {
  170  		const dir = path.dirname(fpath);
  171  		this.ensureDirSync(dir);
  172  		const tempPath = path.join(dir, `.${path.basename(fpath)}.${Snowflake.next()}.tmp`);
  173  		try {
  174  			fs.writeFileSync(tempPath, content);
  175  			fs.renameSync(tempPath, fpath);
  176  		} catch (err) {
  177  			try {
  178  				if (fs.existsSync(tempPath)) fs.unlinkSync(tempPath);
  179  			} catch (cleanupErr) {
  180  				if (!isEnoent(cleanupErr)) {
  181  					logger.warn("Failed to remove session rewrite temp file", {
  182  						sessionFile: fpath,
  183  						tempPath,
  184  						error: toError(cleanupErr).message,
  185  					});
  186  				}
  187  			}
  188  			if (hasFsCode(err, "EPERM")) {
  189  				fs.writeFileSync(fpath, content);
  190  				return;
  191  			}
  192  			throw toError(err);
  193  		}
  194  	}

  196  	async updateSessionTitle(fpath: string, update: SessionTitleUpdate): Promise<void> {
  197  		const fd = fs.openSync(fpath, "r+");
  198  		try {
  199  			const buf = Buffer.from(serializeTitleSlot(update), "utf-8");
  200  			let offset = 0;
  201  			while (offset < buf.length) {
  202  				const written = fs.writeSync(fd, buf, offset, buf.length - offset, offset);
  203  				if (written === 0) {
  204  					throw new Error("Short write");
  205  				}
  206  				offset += written;
  207  			}
  208  		} catch (err) {
  209  			throw toError(err);
  210  		} finally {
  211  			fs.closeSync(fd);
  212  		}
  213  	}

  253  	async writeTextAtomic(fpath: string, content: string, options?: WriteTextAtomicOptions): Promise<void> {
  254  		const dir = path.resolve(fpath, "..");
  255  		const tempPath = path.join(dir, `.${path.basename(fpath)}.${Snowflake.next()}.tmp`);
  256  		await fs.promises.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
  257  		try {
  258  			await fs.promises.writeFile(tempPath, content);
  259  		} catch (err) {
  260  			this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  261  			throw toError(err);
  262  		}
  263  		// Guard-check + rename MUST NOT be separated by an await. A concurrent
  264  		// synchronous rewrite (flushSync -> #rewriteSynchronously) can otherwise
  265  		// publish a fresh body between the check and the rename, and this stale
  266  		// staged body would overwrite it. Sync rename closes that window.
  267  		if (options?.commitGuard && !options.commitGuard()) {
  268  			this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  269  			return;
  270  		}
  271  		try {
  272  			this.renameSync(tempPath, fpath);
  273  			return;
  274  		} catch (err) {
  275  			if (!hasFsCode(err, "EPERM")) {
  276  				this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  277  				throw toError(err);
  278  			}
  279  			try {
  280  				this.#replaceSessionFileAfterEpermSync(tempPath, fpath, err, options?.commitGuard);

  282  				this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  283  				throw fallbackErr;
  284  			}
  285  		}
  286  	}
  287

  289  	 * Sync rename hook. Split from `rename` so `writeTextAtomic` can perform its
  290  	 * guard-then-publish step without a yield, and so tests can inject
  291  	 * Windows-style EPERM at the sync layer used by the atomic path.
  292  	 */
  293  	renameSync(source: string, target: string): void {
  294  		fs.renameSync(source, target);
  295  	}
  296
  297  	#discardTemp(tempPath: string, targetPath: string): void {
  298  		try {
  299  			fs.unlinkSync(tempPath);
  300  		} catch (err) {
  301  			if (!isEnoent(err)) {
  302  				logger.warn("Failed to remove session rewrite temp file", {
  303  					sessionFile: targetPath,
  304  					tempPath,
  305  					error: toError(err).message,
  306  				});
  307  			}
  308  		}
  309  	}
  310
  311  	#replaceSessionFileAfterEpermSync(
  312  		tempPath: string,
  313  		targetPath: string,
  314  		renameError: unknown,
  315  		commitGuard?: () => boolean,
  316  	): void {
  317  		const dir = path.resolve(targetPath, "..");
  318  		const backupPath = path.join(dir, `${path.basename(targetPath)}.${Snowflake.next()}.bak`);
  319  		try {
  320  			this.renameSync(targetPath, backupPath);
  321  		} catch (moveAsideError) {
  322  			if (isEnoent(moveAsideError)) {
  323  				if (commitGuard && !commitGuard()) {
  324  					this.#discardTemp(tempPath, targetPath);
  325  					return;
  326  				}
  327  				this.renameSync(tempPath, targetPath);
  328  				return;
  329  			}
  330  			throw toError(renameError);
  331  		}

   89  	 * `writeTextSync` publish is still on the wire.
   90  	 */
   91  	drain(): Promise<void>;
   92  }

   94  // FinalizationRegistry to clean up leaked file descriptors
   95  const writerRegistry = new FinalizationRegistry<number>(fd => {
   96  	try {
   97  		fs.closeSync(fd);
   98  	} catch {
   99  		// Ignore - fd may already be closed or invalid
  100  	}
  101  });
  102
  103  class FileSessionStorageWriter implements SessionStorageWriter {
  104  	#fd: number;
  105  	#closed = false;
  106  	#error: Error | undefined;
  107  	#onError: ((err: Error) => void) | undefined;
  108
  109  	constructor(fpath: string, options?: { flags?: "a" | "w"; onError?: (err: Error) => void }) {
  110  		this.#onError = options?.onError;
  111  		const flags = options?.flags ?? "a";
  112  		// Ensure parent directory exists
  113  		const dir = path.dirname(fpath);
  114  		if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
  115  			fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  116  		}
  117  		// Open file once, keep fd for lifetime
  118  		this.#fd = fs.openSync(fpath, flags === "w" ? "w" : "a");
  119  		// Register for cleanup if abandoned without close()
  120  		writerRegistry.register(this, this.#fd, this);
  121  	}
  122
  123  	#recordError(err: unknown): Error {
  124  		const error = toError(err);
  125  		if (!this.#error) this.#error = error;
  126  		this.#onError?.(error);
  127  		return error;
  128  	}
  129
  130  	#writeNow(line: string): void {
  131  		const buf = Buffer.from(line, "utf-8");
  132  		let offset = 0;
  133  		while (offset < buf.length) {
  134  			const written = fs.writeSync(this.#fd, buf, offset, buf.length - offset);
  135  			if (written === 0) {
  136  				throw new Error("Short write");
  137  			}
  138  			offset += written;
  139  		}
  140  	}
  141
  142  	appendSync(line: string): void {
  143  		if (this.#closed) throw new Error("Writer closed");
  144  		if (this.#error) throw this.#error;
  145  		// Write in-body so software crash after the call still sees the entry.
  146  		// Microtask batching used to leave completed transcript lines only in
  147  		// memory until the next event-loop turn; process crash then lost every
  148  		// post-checkpoint event. flush/flushSync remain no-op drains (no fsync).
  149  		try {
  150  			this.#writeNow(line);
  151  		} catch (err) {
  152  			throw this.#recordError(err);
  153  		}
  154  	}
  155
  156  	async append(line: string): Promise<void> {
  157  		this.appendSync(line);
  158  	}
  159
  160  	async flush(): Promise<void> {
  161  		if (this.#error) throw this.#error;
  162  	}
  163
  164  	flushSync(): void {
  165  		if (this.#error) throw this.#error;
  166  	}
  167
  168  	isOpen(): boolean {
  169  		return !this.#closed;
  170  	}
  171
  172  	async close(): Promise<void> {
  173  		if (this.#closed) return;
  174  		this.#closed = true;
  175  		// Unregister from finalization - we're closing properly
  176  		writerRegistry.unregister(this);
  177  		try {
  178  			fs.closeSync(this.#fd);
  179  		} catch {
  180  			// Ignore close errors
  181  		}
  182  		if (this.#error) throw this.#error;
  183  	}
  184
  185  	getError(): Error | undefined {
  186  		return this.#error;
  187  	}
  188  }
  189
  190  export class FileSessionStorage implements SessionStorage {
  191  	ensureDirSync(dir: string): void {
  192  		if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
  193  			fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  194  		}
  195  	}
  196
  197  	existsSync(path: string): boolean {
  198  		return fs.existsSync(path);
  199  	}
  200
  201  	writeTextSync(fpath: string, content: string): void {
  202  		const dir = path.dirname(fpath);
  203  		this.ensureDirSync(dir);
  204  		const tempPath = path.join(dir, `.${path.basename(fpath)}.${Snowflake.next()}.tmp`);
  205  		try {
  206  			fs.writeFileSync(tempPath, content);
  207  			fs.renameSync(tempPath, fpath);
  208  		} catch (err) {
  209  			try {
  210  				if (fs.existsSync(tempPath)) fs.unlinkSync(tempPath);
  211  			} catch (cleanupErr) {
  212  				if (!isEnoent(cleanupErr)) {
  213  					logger.warn("Failed to remove session rewrite temp file", {
  214  						sessionFile: fpath,
  215  						tempPath,
  216  						error: toError(cleanupErr).message,
  217  					});
  218  				}
  219  			}
  220  			if (hasFsCode(err, "EPERM")) {
  221  				fs.writeFileSync(fpath, content);
  222  				return;
  223  			}
  224  			throw toError(err);
  225  		}
  226  	}
  227
  228  	async updateSessionTitle(fpath: string, update: SessionTitleUpdate): Promise<void> {
  229  		const fd = fs.openSync(fpath, "r+");

  232  			let offset = 0;
  233  			while (offset < buf.length) {
  234  				const written = fs.writeSync(fd, buf, offset, buf.length - offset, offset);
  235  				if (written === 0) {

  239  			}
  240  		} catch (err) {
  241  			throw toError(err);

  244  		}
  245  	}

  285  	async writeTextAtomic(fpath: string, content: string, options?: WriteTextAtomicOptions): Promise<void> {
  286  		const dir = path.resolve(fpath, "..");
  287  		const tempPath = path.join(dir, `.${path.basename(fpath)}.${Snowflake.next()}.tmp`);
  288  		await fs.promises.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
  289  		try {
  290  			await fs.promises.writeFile(tempPath, content);
  291  		} catch (err) {
  292  			this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  293  			throw toError(err);
  294  		}
  295  		// Guard-check + rename MUST NOT be separated by an await. A concurrent
  296  		// synchronous rewrite (flushSync -> #rewriteSynchronously) can otherwise
  297  		// publish a fresh body between the check and the rename, and this stale
  298  		// staged body would overwrite it. Sync rename closes that window.
  299  		if (options?.commitGuard && !options.commitGuard()) {
  300  			this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  301  			return;
  302  		}
  303  		try {
  304  			this.renameSync(tempPath, fpath);
  305  			return;
  306  		} catch (err) {
  307  			if (!hasFsCode(err, "EPERM")) {
  308  				this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  309  				throw toError(err);
  310  			}
  311  			try {
  312  				this.#replaceSessionFileAfterEpermSync(tempPath, fpath, err, options?.commitGuard);
  313  			} catch (fallbackErr) {
  314  				this.#discardTemp(tempPath, fpath);
  315  				throw fallbackErr;
  316  			}
  317  		}
  318  	}

01 · Task 是内建多 Agent 调度器，支持 batch、async 与结构化 yield

SOURCE FACT

TaskTool 发现 bundled/user/project agent；batch call 强制 shared context 和非空 tasks，每项可选 agent/effort/isolation/outputSchema；async 交给 job manager，sync 按 semaphore 并发并合并 usage/artifacts。子 Agent 必须通过 yield 交付，可增量分段并做 schema validation。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

主 Agent 可以一次发一组有共同背景的任务，每个工人独立选角色和输出合同；结果不是随便一段聊天，而是显式交付。

IMPLICATION

比 subprocess 示例级子 Agent 更接近真正控制平面。

   62  function createUsageTotals(): Usage {
   63  	return {
   64  		input: 0,
   65  		output: 0,
   66  		cacheRead: 0,
   67  		cacheWrite: 0,
   68  		totalTokens: 0,
   69  		cost: { input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0, total: 0 },
   70  	};
   71  }
   72
   73  function addUsageTotals(target: Usage, usage: Partial<Usage>): void {
   74  	const input = usage.input ?? 0;
   75  	const output = usage.output ?? 0;
   76  	const cacheRead = usage.cacheRead ?? 0;
   77  	const cacheWrite = usage.cacheWrite ?? 0;
   78  	const totalTokens = usage.totalTokens ?? input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite;
   79  	const cost =
   80  		usage.cost ??
   81  		({
   82  			input: 0,
   83  			output: 0,
   84  			cacheRead: 0,
   85  			cacheWrite: 0,
   86  			total: 0,
   87  		} satisfies Usage["cost"]);
   88
   89  	target.input += input;
   90  	target.output += output;
   91  	target.cacheRead += cacheRead;
   92  	target.cacheWrite += cacheWrite;
   93  	target.totalTokens += totalTokens;
   94  	target.cost.input += cost.input;
   95  	target.cost.output += cost.output;
   96  	target.cost.cacheRead += cost.cacheRead;
   97  	target.cost.cacheWrite += cost.cacheWrite;
   98  	target.cost.total += cost.total;
   99  }

  124  /**
02
L1factcollaboration

02 · 递归、并发、预算、闲置 park 与冷恢复都有硬合同

SOURCE FACT

默认 maxConcurrency=32、maxRecursionDepth=2、softRequestBudget=200，超过预算提示收尾、1.5x 强制 yield；idle 420 秒后可 park 到磁盘。reviver 从 session_init 恢复 cwd、tools、spawn policy、depth、MCP gate 和 yield requirement，缺失 workspace 时只保留 transcript。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

工人不会无限生工人，也能在闲置时卸载、之后按原权限复活；恢复时不凭猜测重建能力。

IMPLICATION

长任务资源治理和 durable collaboration 明显领先多数 CLI Agent。

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 4505–4558
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 4559–4614
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.

03 · 兄弟 Agent 可用 hub 实时协作，不只回传父节点

SOURCE FACT

同批多个子 Agent 会收到 hub 协作建议；AgentRegistry 维护 live/idle/parked 实例，hub 支持 list/message/broadcast/wait，主会话与 RPC 也能显示和路由子 Agent 状态。

PLAIN LANGUAGE

几个工人不必各做各的等老板汇总，可以在工作中互相发消息、广播冲突和等待对方。

IMPLICATION

减少串行 handoff，但需要冲突检测、消息审计和身份权限。

  412  /**
  413   * Suggestion — never a rejection — nudging the spawner to coordinate via the
  414   * hub when one call creates ≥2 live siblings and it still holds spawn
  415   * capacity. Returns undefined when there is nothing to coordinate or peer
  416   * messaging is unavailable.
  417   */
  418  export function buildCoordinationAdvisory(
  419  	items: TaskItem[],
  420  	depthCapacity: boolean,
  421  	ircEnabled: boolean,
  422  ): string | undefined {
  423  	if (!depthCapacity || !ircEnabled || items.length < 2) return undefined;
  424  	return (
  425  		`Coordinate: ${items.length} siblings are running together. If their work overlaps, have them ` +
  426  		`message each other via \`hub\` (by id, or "all" to broadcast) before editing shared files — ` +
  427  		`live coordination beats a serial handoff. Check \`hub\` op:"list" to see who is doing what.`
  428  	);
  429  }
  430
  431  /**
  432   * Compose the non-blocking advisory appended to a `task` result: the
  433   * specialization nudge (from the per-item resolved agent types), plus — only
  434   * when some spawns keep running after this call (`willRunAsync`) — the
  435   * coordination suggestion over those still-live spawns (`items`). Coordination
  436   * is gated on async because a sync spawn has already finished by the time the
  437   * call returns, so a "coordinate while they run" hint would misfire. Returns
  438   * undefined when neither applies.
  439   */
  440  export function composeSpawnAdvisory(args: {
  441  	agents: string[];
  442  	items: TaskItem[];
  443  	depthCapacity: boolean;
  444  	ircEnabled: boolean;
  445  	willRunAsync: boolean;
  446  }): string | undefined {
  447  	return (
  448  		[
  449  			buildSpecializationAdvisory(args.agents, args.depthCapacity),
  450  			args.willRunAsync ? buildCoordinationAdvisory(args.items, args.depthCapacity, args.ircEnabled) : undefined,
  451  		]
  452  			.filter(Boolean)
  453  			.join("\n\n") || undefined
  454  	);
  455  }
